─── Global Hardening ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| Hostname               | FortiGate                        |
| Strong Crypto          | disable                          |
| Static Key Ciphers     | enable                           |
| DH Params              | 1024                             |
| Admin Timeout          | 480                              |
| Lockout Threshold      | 0                                |
| Lockout Duration       | 0                                |
| Pre-Login Banner       | disable                          |
| Post-Login Banner      | disable                          |
| HTTPS Redirect         | disable                          |
| GUI Certificate        | self-sign                        |
| Password Policy        | disable                          |
| Revision Backup        | disable                          |
| REST API Admin         |                                  |
| Unnamed Policy GUI     |                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
Findings:
  [HIGH] Global: strong-crypto disabled — weak ciphers (RC4/DES/MD5) may be negotiated for management TLS.
  [MEDIUM] Global: ssl-static-key-ciphers not disabled — forward secrecy not enforced.
  [CRITICAL] Global: DH params 1024-bit — critically weak; upgrade to 4096+ immediately.
  [HIGH] Global: admin lockout threshold 0 — brute-force lockout disabled.
  [HIGH] Global: admin lockout duration 0 — account unlocks immediately.
  [MEDIUM] Global: admin timeout 480 min — reduce to 15-30 min.
  [INFO] Global: pre-login-banner disabled — no legal warning before authentication.
  [INFO] Global: post-login-banner disabled — no acceptable-use notice after login.
  [MEDIUM] Global: admin-https-redirect not enabled — HTTP management not auto-redirected to HTTPS.
  [INFO] Global: management GUI using self-signed certificate.
  [INFO] Global: default hostname 'FortiGate' — change to naming convention to reduce fingerprinting.
  [INFO] Global: revision-image-auto-backup disabled — config versioning not automated.
  [MEDIUM] Global: admin-password-policy not enabled — no complexity requirements enforced.

  [HIGH] Local-in: source is 'all' — FortiGate management services accessible from any host.
  [MEDIUM] Local-in: service ALL — restrict to required management protocols only.
  [CRITICAL] Local-in: ACCEPT from 'all' sources — FortiGate control plane broadly exposed.


─── System DNS Security ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| Primary DNS            |                                  |
| Secondary DNS          |                                  |
| DNSSEC                 |                                  |
| DNS-over-TLS           |                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
Findings:
  [MEDIUM] SystemDNS: no primary DNS server configured.
  [INFO] SystemDNS: no secondary DNS server — single point of failure for DNS resolution.
  [MEDIUM] SystemDNS: DNSSEC validation disabled — DNS response spoofing/poisoning possible.
  [INFO] SystemDNS: DNS-over-TLS not configured for system DNS — FortiGate's own DNS queries unencrypted.
